test_policy.notes: APU's freshman page says it no longer considers ACT, SAT or CLT scores as a basis for admission; scores may still be used to waive course requirements or to set additional academic scholarship awards. The 2026-27 catalog lists SAT/ACT as optional for international first-year applicants. SAT/ACT scores do not replace the English proficiency requirement on the pages reviewed.

requirements.supplemental_essays: Personal statement of one to two pages (required) plus a signed Statement of Agreement with Institutional Policy.
requirements.notes: Apply on the APU portal or the Common App (submit only one). International first-years also send sealed official high school transcripts, a foreign transcript evaluation, proof of English proficiency, a passport copy, and a bank statement with the Undergraduate Affidavit of Financial Support. Recommendations are not required (a character reference from a pastor, coach or employer is encouraged); the catalog lists a minimum U.S.-system 2.75 high school GPA for international applicants (3.0 for full consideration on the domestic freshman page; 2.5-2.99 may get conditional admission). BSN nursing and some arts programs need extra materials. Interview policy is not stated.

deadlines.label: Priority application deadline, international (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: International Services page: Feb. 15 is the recommended priority date for admission and scholarship consideration (no year printed; treated as fall 2027). Admission is rolling and a waiting list may begin before the final date. The domestic freshman page lists Mar. 1 priority instead.

deadlines.label: Final deadline for applicants outside the U.S. (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Final deadline is June 1 for applicants already inside the U.S. Applications may face an enrollment waiting list before these dates. Conflict: the International Services page also lists an Early Action date (Dec. 3, freshmen only) and the 2026-27 catalog lists Nov. 15, but the domestic freshman page says APU has no early action, so no Early Action deadline is recorded here.

deadlines.label: BSN Nursing freshman deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Freshman page: all BSN materials, including prerequisite proof and a one-page nursing goals statement, are due by Nov. 15 (taken as Nov. 15, 2026 for fall 2027). BSN applicants should show a 3.5 minimum GPA. International eligibility for the BSN is not stated.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exempt if all of the following are documented: at least two years of full-time secondary or postsecondary study in English without ESL/EFL support (catalog: 48 semester units), ended no more than two years before applying, with an official letter from the school confirming English as the language of instruction. Otherwise TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo; PTE and Cambridge are not listed. Test results are valid 2 years. Applicants at the conditional score levels may be required to take TESL 100 (a credit-bearing university English course); TESL 500 is offered as extra support. No separate ESL pathway program is described on the pages reviewed (an older ALCI page returned 404).

english.notes: International Services page: total 80 with these section minimums. The 2026-27 catalog lists only sections (L20 R20 W22 S18) and a conditional level of L16 R16 W18 S15, where TESL 100 may be required. Admissions considers component scores.
International Services page says 6.5 overall for undergraduates; the 2026-27 catalog says 6.0 (conditional 5.5, possibly with TESL 100). The higher figure is recorded; confirm with admissions.
Same minimum on the International Services page and the catalog.

aid.notes: APU says every admitted traditional undergraduate gets some academic scholarship based on GPA and test scores. 2027-28 table (first-years, per year, renewable up to four years): Trustees full tuition; Presidents $24,000 (GPA 4.25+); Provosts $23,000 (4.0-4.24); Deans $21,000 (3.5-3.99); Directors $19,000 (3.0-3.49); Mary Hill Award $15,000 (under 3.0). The scholarship page does not say whether international students are eligible; an undated APU article says international students not winning the other merit awards are considered for International Scholarship I and II and the APU Grant (amounts there are outdated and not recorded). International students are not eligible for U.S. federal aid.

cost.notes: APU 2026-27 estimate for a first-year living on campus: tuition (12-18 units) $45,980, university service fee $800, housing $6,490, dining plan $4,800 = $58,070 (books and other costs not included). For F-1/J-1 visas the International Services page says proof of funds must show $65,871 for undergraduates, pending new health insurance costs.

majors.notes: Freshman applicants submit prerequisite proof and a goals statement by Nov. 15; the page asks for a 3.5 minimum GPA. International eligibility is not stated.

sat.note: No SAT institution code is printed on the APU admissions pages reviewed; APU does not use SAT scores for admission decisions.

act.note: No ACT institution code is printed on the APU admissions pages reviewed.

toefl.note: APU institution code for official score reports (valid 2 years).

ielts.note: The page says official score reports must be requested to be sent to APU; no IELTS code is listed.

duolingo.note: The page says official score reports must be sent to APU; no Duolingo code is listed.
